reviews.name: Sophie Laurent
reviews.text: Café Regina has become my second home. The atmosphere is unmatched — warm, cozy, and always welcoming. Their Regina Latte is absolutely divine.

reviews.name: Marcus Chen
reviews.text: Best pour-over in the city, hands down. You can tell they care about every detail, from the beans to the cup. Exceptional quality.

reviews.name: Elena Petrova
reviews.text: The pastries here are incredible — the almond croissant is a must-try! Beautiful interior design too. A perfect brunch spot.

reviews.name: James Whitfield
reviews.text: I come here every morning before work. The staff remembers my order, the coffee is consistently perfect, and the ambiance is serene.

reviews.name: Amara Osei
reviews.text: From the aesthetics to the taste — everything about Café Regina screams quality. Their avocado toast is the best I've ever had.

reviews.name: David Kim
reviews.text: A hidden gem! The cold brew is smooth and refreshing. The minimalist decor creates such a peaceful environment for working or catching up with friends.
